skills.name: ls20_action1_moves
skills.description: In game LS20, ACTION1 moves the moving object up by 5 cells.
skills.usage_hint: Use ACTION1 when you need to move up by 5 cells.

skills.name: ls20_action2_effect
skills.description: In game LS20, ACTION2 usually causes a tiny change, mostly lime -> green cells.
skills.usage_hint: Expect ACTION2 to recolour lime regions.

skills.name: ls20_action3_moves
skills.description: In game LS20, ACTION3 moves the moving object left by 5 cells.
skills.usage_hint: Use ACTION3 when you need to move left by 5 cells.

skills.name: ls20_action4_moves
skills.description: In game LS20, ACTION4 moves the moving object right by 5 cells.
skills.usage_hint: Use ACTION4 when you need to move right by 5 cells.

skills.name: bfs_to_target
skills.description: Shortest 4-connected path length between two cells, treating the given colours as impassable. Use it to check reachability before committing to a route.

skills.name: grid_region
skills.description: Print raw colour indices for a rectangle of the grid, to pin down an exact click coordinate.

skills.name: obstacle_map
skills.description: Classify each colour as wall-like or item-like from how its cells clump, and report which colours touch the border.

skills.name: player_detector
skills.description: Rank which object is most likely the agent-controlled sprite (small, uniquely coloured component).
